thread:
opsbot: :rotating_light: Pager alert: increased 5xx rate from Control Plane -> Console API (us-west-2) starting ~2005432087. Auto-silenced after 30s. Paging @emma_oncall @kai_sre @jordan_eng

emma_oncall: on it. pinging in from on-call. Is this customer-visible or internal console-only?

kai_sre: seeing spike in console errors, but control-plane /api/internal/generate seems to be responding fine to synthetic checks. need logs to confirm.

jordan_eng: checking routing — looks like console requests to /console/state are 502s. API backend (dataplane) shows normal success rates. Possible mismatch between console cache and control-plane state.

maria_prod: customer-facing: 2 customers in EU reported 'Console returned an error' around 15:07 UTC. No reported user request failures from the app side yet. I'll open a customer incident ticket and note limited console UI impact.

opsbot: incident created: INCIDENT-200543 (Console API sync failure). Severity: S2. Bridge: #incident-200543.

emma_oncall: forming quick timeline. if control-plane metrics are ok and dataplane is serving, likely a propagation or config flag issue to console proxies. Kai, can you paste the failing proxy logs?

kai_sre: grabbing logs now — pasting snippet:

```
[2005432091] proxy-console-2 | ERROR http: upstream returned 502 for /console/state?session=abc123
[2005432092] proxy-console-2 | WARN config: missing feature_flag:enable_ui_kv
[2005432093] control-plane | INFO config-push commit=cf3a9b2 author=jordan timestamp=2005432075
[2005432094] proxy-console-2 | INFO attempt fallback to legacy-state
```

jordan_eng: commit cf3a9b2 was a config push that toggled `enable_ui_kv` as part of a canary. I rolled it out to control-plane in us-west-2 at 2005432075. Did the workers pick it up?

devops_kate: I see the restart sequence for proxy-console pods at 2005432088 (autoscaler). If proxies restarted right after the config push, they might have started before the new config was applied to their mount/etcd-watch.

sre_rohit: hypothesis: race between config push and pod restart -> proxies read old/truncated config -> missing flag -> code path throws 502 when requesting console transform. Data plane endpoints unaffected.

emma_oncall: good hypothesis. let's validate: 1) check control-plane config store revision at 2005432085, 2) check pod env/config for proxy-console-2 at that time, 3) see if rolling restart started immediately after the push. Kai can you grep etcd/control-config for revision history?

kai_sre: grepping etcd logs now. found:

```
etcd: set key /configs/ui/feature_flags revision=1254 timestamp=2005432076 value="{\"enable_ui_kv\":true}"
etcd: snapshot save at 2005432090
```

kai_sre: revision existed, but proxy-console-2 started at 2005432088 and its startup logs show config-watch handshake failing once then retrying.

jordan_eng: that aligns. startup race where the proxy process queried config before etcd watch was ready and treated missing flag as fatal for that handler. we added a stricter failure mode in the last change.

maria_prod: customer impact update: opened priority ticket with affected customers, included workaround (use API directly) and communicated limited scope.

emma_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) mark the canary rollback for cf3a9b2 (rollback flag), 2) restart proxy-console pods one-by-one after confirming config watch is healthy, 3) add temporary fallback to assume default flag=false rather than error. Who can do the rollback?

jordan_eng: I can rollback the config push (cf3a9b2 -> revert to cf3a9a1) and will monitor. rolling back now.

incidents_bot: deploy started by jordan_eng: revert-config cf3a9b2 -> cf3a9a1. ETA 2m.

jordan_eng: revert complete. etcd now shows revision=1252 at 2005432150 for previous config.

kai_sre: restarting proxy-console-2 gracefully now (kubectl rollout restart deploy/proxy-console -n prod --selector=pod=proxy-console-2). restarting sequentially.

```
kubectl get pods -n prod | grep proxy-console
proxy-console-1  Running  2/2  6d
proxy-console-2  Terminating  0/2  3m
proxy-console-3  Running  2/2  6d
```

emma_oncall: monitoring error rates. console 5xx rate back to baseline at 2005432207. Maria, please update customer tickets: issue mitigated, working on RCA.

maria_prod: updated customers. they confirmed consoles are reachable again. closing immediate incident impact.

kai_sre: for RCA notes: captured logs, etcd revisions, pod restart timestamps. saving artifacts to gcs://redwood-incidents/200543/ (links: https://gcs.example/200543/logs, https://gcs.example/200543/metrics)

sre_rohit: adding hypothesis tracker in-thread:
- H1: config push cf3a9b2 + autoscaler restart -> proxy read stale/missing config -> handler threw 502 (supported by proxy logs showing missing flag)
- H2: control-plane push corrupted payload to etcd (no evidence, etcd shows correct value)
- H3: network partition between control-plane and proxies for short window (no packet loss on infra metrics)

emma_oncall: H1 most likely. Action items:
- jordan_eng: add defensive defaults to UI proxy code to treat missing flag as false (PR + test)
- devops_kate: change deploy sequence to confirm config watchers healthy before pod rollout (pre-check)
- kai_sre: add metric/alert for proxy config-watch failures
- rohit: draft RCA and timeline, include artifacts links

jordan_eng: created PR #4821 with fallback behavior and unit tests. linking: https://gh.example/redwood/infra/pulls/4821

devops_kate: will update deployment runbook to add a gating check (etcd revision consistent across control-plane nodes) before canary rollout.

incidents_bot: bridge closed. incident severity downgraded to S3 at 2005432240.

emma_oncall: moving to post-incident RCA sync tomorrow 09:00 PT. I'll assign owners and put a draft in the postmortems workspace. Thanks for the quick repsond. :thumbsup:

maria_prod: adding customer-impact summary to the ticket and noting impacted sessions ~120 over 3 mins, no data loss.

sre_rohit: timeline for RCA doc (short):
- 2005432075 control-plane config push cf3a9b2
- 2005432088 proxy-console-2 restart (autoscaler)
- 2005432091 first 502 observed in proxy logs
- 2005432148 config revert cf3a9a1 by jordan_eng
- 2005432207 5xx rates back to baseline
- 2005432240 incident downgraded

emma_oncall: final note: this is a control-plane->console sync issue, dataplane serving path unaffected. We'll treat controls that toggle UI-specific flags as low-risk but add extra gating. Closing thread.
